name: ggb-bridge
summary:
Rebuilt plot 0 only, in parts/tower.mjs (tower-skin.mjs is now empty): legs are fluted on every face and step back on the outer sides at y 52/70/88 with stair ledges. The struts have nested recessed frames, the portal openings have stepped stair corners, the crown has tiers up to red warning lights at y 116, and the X brace below the deck is 2 thick.
A diff against v1 shows changes only in the tower box (x 14..32); plots 1-3, the pier, fender, deck and walkways are byte-identical. The cable grooves x 16/30 at y 112..113 are open, nothing is above y 116, the build ran with nothing refused or off-palette, and the orphan count is the same as v1 (8).

revisions.comment:
The modules sit exactly right on the site; only the TOWER (plot 0) needs work, it reads as two flat slabs with slots instead of the Golden Gate's Art Deco tower:
1. Leg faces are flat. Each leg is a cluster of riveted steel cells: give every face of both legs strong vertical relief, 2 or 3 recessed vertical channels (1 deep, 1 wide) per face, running the full height between the portal struts, so the legs read as fluted.
2. The legs do not step. Make each leg narrow in setbacks as it rises, by 1 block on its outer sides at about y 52, y 70 and y 88, with a ledge of stairs/slabs at each setback (the inner faces stay where they are so the portal openings keep their width).
3. The portal struts are plain bars and the openings plain rectangles. Each strut face should show nested recessed rectangular frames (2 or 3 steps deep, the iconic stepped Art Deco panels), and each opening between the legs should have stepped/chamfered top corners (stairs), as on the real towers.
4. The top is abrupt: give each leg a stepped crown of 2 or 3 diminishing tiers up to y 114..116 around the cable saddle housings, with red warning lights at the very top.
5. Below the deck the X brace is a thin line: make it a substantial 2-thick X (or K) truss brace between the legs from just above the pier to y 33.
6. Colour: the body may stay orange_terracotta (it is recoloured at placement); use red_terracotta in the recesses and channels for shadow contrast.
KEEP EXACTLY: the plot box (x 0..46, z 0..23, up to y 116); the legs' footprints at the base (x 14..18 and x 28..32, z 8..15) and their inner faces; the road through the portal (road y 38, x 19..27, through the whole z 0..23) with its truss y 34..37 and the sidewalk walkways around the legs; the cells on x 16 and x 30 at y 112..113 open for the cables; the pier and fender. Do NOT change plots 1, 2 and 3 at all.
revisions.summary:
Rebuilt plot 0 only, in parts/tower.mjs (tower-skin.mjs is now empty): legs are fluted on every face and step back on the outer sides at y 52/70/88 with stair ledges. The struts have nested recessed frames, the portal openings have stepped stair corners, the crown has tiers up to red warning lights at y 116, and the X brace below the deck is 2 thick.
A diff against v1 shows changes only in the tower box (x 14..32); plots 1-3, the pier, fender, deck and walkways are byte-identical. The cable grooves x 16/30 at y 112..113 are open, nothing is above y 116, the build ran with nothing refused or off-palette, and the orphan count is the same as v1 (8).
applied: 1 Fluting: 1-deep, 1-wide channels on every leg face; the front cell is left out with red_terracotta behind it. 2 channels per face on the 5/6-wide faces (x 15/17, z 10/13); they run between orange_concrete band courses at y 6..7, 50..51, 68..69, 86..87 and 110..111. Faces stay solid at deck level (y 34..39) and wherever a strut, haunch or the brace meets the leg. Shroomlight lamp panels are set into the inner faces at y 40..41.

2 Setbacks: y 52 north/south faces (z 8..15 -> 9..14), y 70 outer x face (x 14 -> 15, east 32 -> 31), y 88 north/south (-> z 10..13), each with a smooth_red_sandstone stair ledge. The inner faces x 18/28 never move and the base footprints are unchanged.

3 Struts: the struts at y 55..60 and 72..77 are 6 deep (z 9..14, matching the legs there), with a flush frame, a ring recessed 1 and a centre recessed 2, backed in red_terracotta. The struts at y 90..95 and 106..112 are 4 deep: flush frame, ring recessed 1, raised orange_concrete panel. Each opening below a strut has 3-step stair corners (upside-down stairs), which read as Art Deco arches.

4 Crown: saddle housing at y 112..113 with an orange band on top and the x 16/30 groove open, then a stair-skirted roof tier at y 114, a glowstone tier with slab ends at y 115, and 2x2 red_stained_glass warning lights at y 116 on each leg. The top-strut crown (y 113/114 with shroomlight) is kept.
5 X brace: two diagonals, each 2 thick in x and 4 deep (z 10..13), from the tie at y 6..7 up to the lower strut at y 28..33 (which carries the deck), mirrored between the legs.
6 Colour: the body stays orange_terracotta, with red_terracotta in every channel and recess and orange_concrete bands and panels.
skipped: Struts at y 90..95 and 106..112 can't take a 2-deep nested recess, because the legs and struts are only 4 deep there and recessing 2 from both faces would cut through. They get a recessed ring plus a raised orange panel instead (the nearest sensible version).
The top stages (4 wide) get 1 channel per face (2 wide on the side faces) instead of 2-3, because a 4-wide face has no room for more.
plan.md still describes the v1 tower; parts/tower.mjs is now the reference for the tower's coordinates.
